research_basis.source: Scaling Managed Agents: decoupling brain from hands

implemented_invariants: UnifiedDB remains the single canonical durable state authority
autonomy is a bounded supervisor state machine, not a consciousness daemon
operational identity contains runtime facts, not metaphysical AGI claims
goals are canonical state and cannot be minted or completed by model prose
model proposal schema contains no succeeded/completed/executed authority fields
model-visible capabilities equal goal allowlist intersected with actual EffectGate capabilities
goal success requires all predeclared typed canonical verifiers
effect completion evidence must be causally bound to exact goal and step resource refs
unexpected executor failure becomes UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and is not automatically retried
open step after supervisor lease loss becomes UNKNOWN/BLOCKED rather than replayed
interactive canonical turns take priority over autonomous work
max steps, failures, effects, repeated-failure streak and bounded run ticks stop runaway loops
append-only goal events plus a canonical autonomy-state digest make decisions auditable and out-of-band state mutation detectable
test_obligations_committed: unavailable capability is not advertised as present
model-smuggled success/executed fields are rejected before executor
typed checkpoint evidence completes only after open step closes
repeated identical invalid proposals hit deterministic loop brake
out-of-band goal-state mutation triggers digest mismatch
verified effect must bind to exact goal-step resources
successful effect from another resource path cannot satisfy goal

execution_evidence.note: No executable PASS is promoted from source inspection or internal design coherence. Exact focused/adjacent tests remain required on an admitted isolated runner.

integration_boundary.reason: The first source candidate deliberately avoids duplicating or overwriting moving provider/runtime/schema authority lanes. These must be fused exactly once after executable review.
